- 2 cups flour
- 2 eggs
- 1.5 cups milk
- 2 tbsp sugar
- 1 tsp baking powder
- 1/2 tsp salt
- Butter for cooking

1. Mix flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt in a bowl.
2. In another bowl, whisk eggs and milk together.
3. Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and mix until smooth.
4. Heat a pan with butter over medium heat.
5. Pour batter onto the pan and cook until bubbles form.
6. Flip and cook until golden brown.
7. Serve with maple syrup or your favorite topping.

- 3 eggs
- 2 tbsp butter
- Salt and pepper to taste
- 1/4 cup cheese (optional)
- Fresh herbs (optional)

1. Crack eggs into a bowl and beat with a fork.
2. Season with salt and pepper.
3. Melt butter in a non-stick pan over medium heat.
4. Pour in eggs and let cook for 1-2 minutes.
5. Add cheese and herbs if desired.
6. Fold omelette in half when almost set.
7. Cook for another minute and serve hot.

- 1 head lettuce
- 2 tomatoes
- 1 cucumber
- 1/4 red onion
- Olive oil
- Salt and pepper
- Lemon juice

1. Wash and chop lettuce into bite-sized pieces.
2. Dice tomatoes and cucumber.
3. Thinly slice red onion.
4. Combine all vegetables in a large bowl.
5. Drizzle with olive oil and lemon juice.
6. Season with salt and pepper.
7. Toss gently and serve fresh.

- 6 ripe tomatoes
- 1 onion
- 2 cloves garlic
- 2 cups vegetable broth
- 1/2 cup cream
- Fresh basil
- Salt and pepper

1. Chop tomatoes, onion, and garlic.
2. Sauté onion and garlic in a pot until soft.
3. Add tomatoes and cook for 10 minutes.
4. Pour in vegetable broth and simmer for 20 minutes.
5. Blend soup until smooth.
6. Stir in cream and season to taste.
7. Garnish with fresh basil and serve.

- 400g spaghetti
- 200g guanciale or bacon
- 4 egg yolks
- 100g pecorino cheese
- Black pepper
- Salt

1. Cook spaghetti according to package directions.
2. Cut guanciale into small pieces and fry until crispy.
3. Mix egg yolks with grated pecorino cheese.
4. Drain pasta, reserving some cooking water.
5. Add hot pasta to the pan with guanciale.
6. Remove from heat and quickly stir in egg mixture.
7. Add pasta water if needed for creaminess.
8. Season with black pepper and serve immediately.

- 2 beef steaks (ribeye or sirloin)
- 2 tbsp olive oil
- 2 cloves garlic
- Fresh rosemary
- Salt and pepper
- Butter

1. Take steaks out of refrigerator 30 minutes before cooking.
2. Season with salt, pepper, and olive oil.
3. Heat a grill or cast iron pan until very hot.
4. Sear steaks for 3-4 minutes per side.
5. Add garlic, butter, and rosemary to the pan.
6. Baste steaks with the butter.
7. Let rest for 5 minutes before slicing.
8. Serve with your favorite sides.
